LESSON: FORWARD ROLL AND V-BALANCE

Grade: SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade three
Subject: CREATIVE ACTIVITIES
Strand: Performing and Display
Topic 2.4: Forward Roll and V-balance
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 14

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Forward Roll and V-balance, part of Performing and Display in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade three CREATIVE ACTIVITIES.

Key inquiry question: How can forward roll and V balance be used to improve flexibility and balance?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Forward Roll and V-balance together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Values:
• Love: The learner appreciates their own ability in practising forward roll and V balance.

• Social justice: The learner shares materials equitably with peers for making markers.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
• Personal Hygiene: The learner cleans the working and stores markers after performance.

• Environmental conservation: The learner collects reusable materials.

Link to other subjects:

• Environmental activities: The learner observes hygiene while collecting and sharing simple reusable materials.

• Religious Activities: The learner applies values while working in groups.
